objects.name: Reeve Aldous
objects.greeting: Brasswick keeps its books straight and its streets lit. Lately, only one of those.
objects.topics: The town=Everything the Vale makes is sold in this square. Mind the prices at the Blade.; The mine=The lamps in the Copperpit went out a month ago. Nobody will tell me why.

objects.name: Captain Rhosyn
objects.greeting: State your business. No - never mind. You have the look of someone useful.
objects.topics: The watchtower=The Bortzal burnt the hill bare and shut the gate. It takes a silver key - the marsh warden carries one.; The Bortzal=Yellow, quick and never alone.

objects.name: Dyer Maud
objects.greeting: Blue. Everyone wants blue this year, and there is not a bilberry in the town.

objects.name: Guard
objects.greeting: Keep your blade sheathed in the square.

objects.name: Marta
objects.greeting: The Quill has a scroll that will take you straight home. Worth every coin.

objects.name: Jory
objects.greeting: They say a dragon's egg came through the Khorigale camp. Nothing hatches from it.

objects.name: Tinker Bell-Anne
objects.greeting: Brass gears, brass keys, brass everything. That is Brasswick.

objects.name: Old Hesk
objects.greeting: I fished the Brassrun before there was a bridge. Trout as long as your arm.

objects.name: Lysa
objects.greeting: The clock has not been right since the lamps went out in the mine.

objects.name: Corwin
objects.greeting: A backpack. That is what you want. You can never carry enough.

objects.title: Word for the Magister
objects.offer: The lamps in the Copperpit went out a month ago. Magister Ilvaren at the Drurin Observatory reads such things in the sky. Ask what the Magister has seen, and bring me the answer.
objects.remind: The observatory stands on its hill, north-east of the town.
objects.thanks: The dead, in my mine. Then it is blades we need, not lamplighters. You have earned this.
objects.reward: coins x90, scroll of insight x1

objects.title: The warlord's head
objects.offer: The Bortzal in the old watchtower answer to one they call Thrakk. Bring him down and the warband breaks. The town will pay, and so will I.
objects.remind: Thrakk keeps to the tower, behind the gate. It takes a silver key.
objects.thanks: Then the north road is open again. Take this - it was my mother's, and it has not been drawn in anger for years.
objects.reward: coins x300, sword crystal x1, greater health potion x2

objects.title: Blue for the vats
objects.offer: Bring me five handfuls of bilberries and I will pay better than the market does.
objects.remind: Bilberries grow in the Whispering Wood, and by Oakhollow.
objects.thanks: Look at that colour. Here - a little luck, bottled.
